description: This Java abstract class 'BaseCompare' provides functionality for comparison operations within the OFBiz minilang framework, specifically for SimpleMapOperations. It handles comparison logic such as executing a comparison with specified parameters and managing related attributes like operator, type, and format.

classes.name: BaseCompare
classes.description: An abstract class providing comparison functionalities for minilang operations, handling attribute parsing and comparison execution.

methods.name: doRealCompare
methods.description: Performs a real comparison between two objects based on provided operator and type, utilizing ObjectType utility.

methods.name: BaseCompare
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the comparison attributes from an XML element.

methods.name: doCompare
methods.description: Executes the comparison between two values and adds a message if the comparison fails.
